answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 41399 Country: India Title: How many rakah are there in tarawih Question: (1) How many rakah are there in tarawih? (2) Is reciting (the name of four Khalifa) tasbih (between 4 rakah and 2 rakah) in tarawih lawful or not? Answer ID: 41399 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1315/879/H=1433) (1) It is twenty rakah. (2) It is not proved to recite the tasbih in the name of four caliphs which is prevalent. Thus it should be given up. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
